name: Kenya Safari Rally Route
creator: Bnuuy
notes: Composite Safari stage: rough, fast and flowing, with the drainage humps and rock sections the live pair modelled as 7 humps and 5 bumps. Distance and altitude are the Kedong stage's near Naivasha. The corner counts and straights are an approximation for the sandbox, not a traced map — count them properly when the real map is at hand. netClimb 0 = not surveyed.
